command-host-only: Only the world host can use these commands (host check required)
command-host-unknown: Unable to identify the world host - commands are blocked; check the xSkills log
command-remote-unsupported: Changing another player requires network synchronization; this version cannot do it yet
command-tier-range: Ability tier must be between 0 and {0}
custominfo-commands:
Host commands
Only the world host (administrator) can use these commands

RaftModLoader console (F10)
Enter commands without a leading /
Player name is optional - when omitted, the command targets the host
Editing other players is not supported yet because network syncing has not been implemented

Skill levels
level add [player] [skill] [levels] - add levels
level set [player] [skill] [level] - set level
level get [player] [skill] - show level
level reset [player] [skill] - reset skill

Experience
exp add [player] [skill] [experience] - add XP
exp set [player] [skill] [experience] - set XP
exp get [player] [skill] - show XP

Ability tiers
tier add [player] [skill] [ability] [tiers] - add tiers
tier set [player] [skill] [ability] [tier] - set tier
tier get [player] [skill] [ability] - show tier

Unlearn points
unlearnpoints add [amount] - add points
unlearnpoints set [amount] - set points
unlearnpoints get - show points

Examples
exp add survival 100
level set cooking 10
tier set sailing steadyhelm 2
unlearnpoints add 5
custominfo-details-1: The skill interface can be adjusted after the layout editor is implemented
custominfo-details-2: Unlearning points allow an ability to be unlearned. This feature requires the gameplay system
custominfo-details-3: Press C by default to open the skills menu. You can rebind it in Raft settings
custominfo-details-4: Click a skill in the Specializations menu to open the transfer window. Transferring experience is disabled until networking is implemented
custominfo-shortdesc-4: How to transfer experience to other players
settings-balance-future: These limits are stored for future abilities. They do not change the game yet and are not synchronized with clients. Multiplayer balance will require host-to-client synchronization when the perks are implemented
settings-balance-intro: Limits for future character ability bonuses. Only the host can change these values
settings-balance-summary: Host only - future ability bonus limits
settings-diet-future: Food and drinks replenish four diet categories: protein, dairy, fruit, and vegetables. Prepared meals are split by ingredients, and honey counts as fruit. Below you can configure the total HP bonus from diet, daily diet decay, and diet loss on death
settings-diet-summary: Bonus health and diet decay rules
settings-overview: Choose a section to view its options. Click a section to pin it on the right
settings-skill-future: This section is prepared for future per-ability balance controls. Settings will appear here when the corresponding perks are implemented
settings-volume-desc: Controls all xSkills sounds: menu clicks, page switches, level-ups and other notifications. Changes take effect immediately and are saved locally
ui-ability-description-unavailable: Ability description is not available yet
ui-home-bonus-note: Diet and bonus HP are live. Other green modifiers are sample values
ui-home-environment-note: Time and weather come from Raft, temperature is calculated
ui-hover-ability: Hover over an ability to see its description
ui-info-pin-hint: Click a section to pin it - use the mouse wheel over the right panel to scroll
ui-levelup-hint: Open the skills menu to view your abilities
ui-player-no-world: Enter a world to view your character
ui-spec-hint: Select a skill to open the experience transfer window
ui-transfer-not-available: Experience transfer is not available until the multiplayer skill progression system is implemented
settings-diet-bonus-rule: Diet bonus health is added to normal maximum health and stretches the main HP bar. Bonus health from drinks is still shown as a separate segment on the right and stacks with diet health
settings-diet-max-bonus: Maximum total HP bonus from diet
